tasks.short: Use special educational techniques during instruction.

steps.what: Choose the immediate special educational technique for the actual child's sensory, motor, language, cognition or memory need
Employ the selected special educational strategies or techniques with the child during instruction
outputs: actual supported instruction and child responses

steps.what: Observe the actual response and change pace, sensory demand or physical support while teaching
inputs: actual supported instruction and child responses

tasks.design: Keep the real-time special educational instruction human. Test existing {LMS} access to the child's already prepared teaching plan, but claim no saving for system runtime or for teaching-plan authoring that belongs to another task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on the child's response during the activity.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing teaching records can make an already approved plan available; they do not perform the instruction.
tasks.still_hard: Adjusting support without overwhelming the child.
tasks.human_edge: Responding sensitively to a young child's individual communication and movement.

ambition.what: No extra instructional capacity is established by this design.

tasks.altitude: Instruction and decision rights stay with the teacher.

reach.task: Deliver the teacher's agreed activity support
reach.learn: Use the child's communication cues and the teacher's support limits.

evidence.claim: Live special educational instruction requires contextual human adaptation; no time reduction is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is employing techniques during actual instruction. Creating individualized plans, preparing teaching materials and writing progress reports are separate work and earn no saving here. A review of possible record, report and send steps found none inherent in this live instructional act; do not invent a post-session note baseline.

The teacher supplies the existing plan's child identifier, goal, technique, support limits and revision. If it is unavailable in the native {LMS}, the teacher reads the authorized paper plan; neither path is assumed faster.
No new software, model, recording or upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether a separate observation record is required during this specific activity.
research_questions: Does observation recording occur here or in the separate progress-record task? Measure it once before extending this boundary.

already_counted.description: Immediate technique selection and live adaptation remain human.

incremental.description: No software or new routine introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All three live instructional steps remain unchanged. No record-writing or plan-authoring baseline is assigned to this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Encourage exploration and perseverance with challenging learning.

steps.what: Notice the actual child's difficulty, interest and readiness and choose an appropriate encouragement
Encourage the child to explore learning opportunities or persevere, adjusting help and challenge during the activity

tasks.design: Protect the actual encouragement and supported exploration. Check whether existing {LMS} resources already supply the agreed classroom activity; this design changes no preparation, record writing or communication step within the act of encouraging a child.
tasks.previous_blocker: Encouragement depends on timing and trust.
tasks.enabler_now: Software can hold existing resources but cannot establish the child's current readiness from a task record.
tasks.still_hard: Finding the right amount of help and challenge.
tasks.human_edge: A trusted adult notices frustration and responds without turning it into a diagnosis.

reach.learn: Agree helpful prompts and when to ask the teacher for help.

evidence.claim: Personal encouragement in a live preschool activity is contextual human work.

assumptions: Boundary is direct encouragement during an already organized activity. No record write, report or send is required by this act; progress records and planning are not hidden in the conversation and are not credited here.

Inputs are the child's observable actions and the teacher's existing activity, not inferred emotions or automatically classified health data. If an existing plan is consulted, its producer is the teacher and the manual fallback is its paper copy.
Native {LMS} configuration was considered for resources; it does not shorten the two live steps. No implementation or ongoing upkeep is proposed, so incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether the school requires a distinct observation entry, owned by its progress-record workflow.
research_questions: Can the school distinguish direct support from subsequent progress documentation in a small time sample?

already_counted.description: Assessing the immediate need for encouragement remains counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The design changes neither immediate judgement nor personal encouragement. Separate documentation has not been invented as a source of saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with adults to resolve a child's behavioral or academic problems.

steps.what: Retrieve the child's authorized learning observations and previous support agreements for the discussion
Confer with parents, guardians, teachers, counselors or administrators and agree appropriate responses to the actual problems
outputs: actual discussion and agreed support actions

steps.what: Write and check the actual support agreement, differing accounts, responsible people and review date in a restricted draft
inputs: actual discussion and agreed support actions
outputs: checked final support agreement and child record target

steps.what: Save the checked actual support agreement to the authorized child's learning record
inputs: checked final support agreement and child record target

tasks.design: Configure a child-specific view in the {LMS} to retrieve authorized prior observations and support agreements. Reuse identity and meeting headers in its native agreement form; the teacher still writes and checks the actual discussion, then saves that final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant existing agreements can sit in separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and reusable form headers can reduce navigation and repeated identity entry.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling different accounts and agreeing support with the family.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust without treating a parent's concern as an automatic diagnosis.

ambition.what: Review one unresolved support agreement sooner when easier retrieval makes the discussion practical.

tasks.altitude: Less navigation; support decisions remain with the existing participants.

reach.learn: Record differing accounts and appropriate escalation boundaries.

evidence.claim: Native pupil records can link prior observations and reuse identity fields; actual family discussion and agreement wording still need human work.

assumptions: Boundary includes discussion references, the conference and its actual support agreement, not preparation of diagnostic assessments or unrelated progress reports.

The teacher or authorized staff produce child ID, observation date, author, observed event, prior action, owner and review date. Missing observations remain manual; do not infer them from planned activities or silently extract family correspondence.

Try native {LMS} views and forms first. The 10% reduction in agreement drafting is only reused identity and meeting headers; all actual statements, agreements and checking remain human. No separate self-approval meeting is added.
Approval a1 binds the completed agreement text, child ID, access and record destination checked in s3; any edit requires rechecking. No onward send is included or assumed.
unknowns: Whether prior agreements are retrievable by child ID in the current system.
Actual navigation versus discussion and note-writing time.
research_questions: Does a native child view reduce reference retrieval without broadening access?

already_counted.description: Actual discussion agreement authoring and final checking stay counted.

incremental.description: Maintain restricted view fields and resolve broken agreement links.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual support agreement text, child ID, access and exact record destination checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If native links reduce retrieval to 65% and reused headers reduce agreement authoring to 90%, gross is 7.15 points, less 0.7 upkeep. Low is no adoption when retrieval is already consolidated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize and supervise developmental games and recreation.

steps.what: Choose games and recreational activities for actual children's physical, mental or social development and support needs
Arrange the actual equipment, space and assistance needed for safe participation
Prepare and check the activity running sheet with selected games, adaptations, equipment and assistance
outputs: checked final activity running sheet and internal location

steps.what: Save the checked activity running sheet to the existing restricted activity folder
inputs: checked final activity running sheet and internal location

steps.what: Supervise actual games and recreation, support participation and adapt to children's responses

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} activity template to assemble the teacher's selected games and confirmed arrangements into the running sheet. Keep activity choice, physical setup, final checking and live supervision with the teacher; the ordinary save earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Running sheets can require repeated copying of activity and equipment headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable native document sections can assemble known activity details without generating developmental advice.
tasks.still_hard: Making the activity safe, inclusive and engaging for this group.
tasks.human_edge: Adjusting actual play and support as children respond.

ambition.what: No additional supervised group is promised.

tasks.altitude: Preparation is slightly shorter; supervision responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Arrange equipment for an agreed developmental activity
reach.learn: Recognize activity-specific adaptations and when to defer to the teacher.

evidence.claim: Native reusable document sections can reduce repeated layout work for an activity running sheet.

assumptions: Boundary is organizing and supervising the activity. The 10% sheet share applies only where a running sheet is actually prepared; do not introduce one to create a saving.

The teacher supplies selected activity ID or name, actual adaptations, sequence, confirmed equipment, assistance and location. Missing facts are entered manually; a stored catalogue is not evidence equipment or help is available.
Try native document templates first. No model loop, pupil assessment, automatic emotion inference or automatic staff notice is required.
The normal final author check in s3 binds the finished running sheet and internal folder for a1. Later edits void that approval. Save and live supervision retain full effort.
unknowns: Whether running sheets already use a native reusable template.
Whether their production occupies any material time.
research_questions: Can the native template remove layout work without adding a new documentation requirement?

already_counted.description: Assemble and check the actual running sheet.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable activity headings and remove obsolete equipment options.

approvals.approved_version: Final activity running sheet, confirmed arrangement details and exact internal folder checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only existing running-sheet work falls from 10 to 6 points; 0.5 upkeep leaves 3.5. Low is no adoption if no sheet exists or it is already templated; physical and teaching steps receive no benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher remains responsible for live instruction, encouragement, family discussion and supervised play. Native record views can remove a small amount of retrieval and layout work.
reach: Coordinate agreed support follow-up with the counselor while keeping diagnostic decisions with qualified staff.
skills_to_grow: Measure preparation work before claiming a saving
role.ambitious_version: Spend any verified preparation time on an earlier conversation about one unresolved support need.
